cases.title: creates a throwaway fixture customs broker for this suite to edit

steps.data: Logged in and navigated to Service Providers > Customs Brokers
Create a customs broker via CustomsBrokersPage.createCustomsBroker(buildFakeCustomsBrokerData()) so later scenarios never mutate a real, pre-existing record

cases.title: updates a customs broker's contact details

steps.target: Edit button (#edit-button, opens an in-page drawer, no navigation)
Contact Name, Telephone Number, Email, Note

steps.expected: "Customs broker updated successfully." banner is shown on the same detail URL (no navigation), which displays the new contact name, telephone number, and email

riskNotes: Unlike Suppliers/Freight Forwarders, this section's index row kebab menu has NO Edit action — editing is only reachable from the detail page's own Edit button, and that button is a client-side drawer toggle, not a link to a separate /edit URL. Verified live, see project_conventions.md.

cases.title: updates a customs broker's company name and location

steps.expected: Detail page heading shows the new company name
Index, searched by the new name, shows a row with the new name and "{city}, {state}, United States" location

riskNotes: The Location column is "{city}, {state}, {country}" — a third, distinct format from Suppliers ("{state}, {country}") and Freight Forwarders ("{city}, {country}") — verified live, see project_conventions.md.

cases.title: shows a validation error when Company Name is cleared

steps.expected: "The company name field is required." validation banner is shown
Index still shows the record under its original (unchanged) name
